as_told.title: Lue Elizondo as a Grey Fox alumnus

plain: Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official central to the UFO story, was part of the Intelligence Support Activity and Gray Fox, secretive units that scout super sensitive areas ahead of the commandos of Joint Special Operations Command, according to a point Michels credits to the online researcher UAPGerb. Michels relays it in one episode as UAPGerb's link between Elizondo and the so-called legacy program, an alleged secret effort holding recovered craft, while in another he simply states on his own that Elizondo "is an alumni of Greyfox", without the credit or the legacy program.
